global_to_tile — DRIVE inf op

• Data kinds: none → any (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.global_to_tile(X: 'float', Y: 'float', tile: 'float') (to call the implementation directly, import driveinf; driveinf.global_to_tile(X: 'float', Y: 'float', tile: 'float'); from the registry, opsdrive.get("global_to_tile"))

Usage

Global coordinates → (i, j, x, y) (for comparison; far-away coordinates have already been rounded to the floating-point step).
